I am sorry to hear your item is damaged. Based on the information we have, there is not a separate process for damaged items, so please return it through our standard returns route.
What you can expect:
Returns are free within the UK.
If you return an item within 30 days of receipt in its original condition, we will refund the amount you paid.
For sale items, please notify us of the return within 14 days by registering with our online returns partner (opens in a new tab), then you have a further 14 days to send it back.
A small number of items are non‑refundable: swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
You can find full details on our policy here: Returns and refunds (opens in a new tab).
If you would like, tell me whether the item is full price or sale and I can confirm the exact steps and timeframes for your return.
